# ArcGIS Flight Component

A browser-only custom element that adds aircraft flight and chase/cockpit cameras to a caller-owned ArcGIS SceneView or arcgis-scene.

Use the component in an existing ArcGIS app, or clone the repository and adapt its demos and source for your own project.

Install: npm install github:ceddc/arcgis-flight-component @arcgis/core@~5.1.24 @arcgis/map-components@~5.1.24
Import: @ceddc/arcgis-flight-component. ArcGIS Map Components is optional for an existing SceneView. SDK range: >=4.30 <5.2; the default entry targets SDK 5.1. See SDK integration for older hosts.

For source changes: clone https://github.com/ceddc/arcgis-flight-component, run npm ci, then npm run dev. See docs/development.md.

The host owns its view, map, layers, authentication, and application UI. The component removes only its own resources and restores borrowed camera/navigation state when stopped or disconnected.

Guides:

Reference:
- docs/configuration.md: options, defaults, attributes, and update behavior

Development:
- docs/codebase-guide.md: file-by-file source and test inventory, orientation, and common-change pointers
- docs/development.md: source map, checks, builds, and debugging
- docs/architecture.md: ownership, lifecycle, and runtime flow
